generation_prompt: The robot closes its right hand around the Rubik's cube on the bottom level of the wooden shelf and lifts it clear. As the person shifts the shelf to the right, the robot raises the cube to the top level, lowers it onto the surface, and opens its hand, leaving the cube upright on the shelf. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
observed_terminal_state: Cube stands upright on the top wooden shelf. Right fingers are open and separated from the cube; right hand remains hovering nearby. Bottom tray is empty, left hand remains uninvolved, and person has moved leftward away from shelf.

arm_hand_roles.right: Only manipulating hand: encloses cube, lifts from bottom tray, raises and transports to top level, sets down and opens to release.
arm_hand_roles.left: Remains open at the left edge without touching cube or shelf; no supporting or stabilizing role.
arm_hand_roles.person: Moves shelf rightward during robot lift by grasping/pushing its frame; does not touch or receive the cube.
arm_hand_roles.coordination: Robot maintains its right-hand grasp during person's shelf repositioning, then places cube on the relocated top level. No bimanual manipulation or handoff.

uncertainties: Exact instant of bottom-surface separation and initial top-surface contact lies between inspected samples; continuous visible transport and final release are unambiguous.
annotation_discrepancies: Original instruction correctly identifies right-hand bottom-to-top cube transfer, but omits the person moving the shelf rightward during the lift.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
